global_preconditions.split: exact-QASM hash-grouped frozen outer split; all tuning is outer-train only
global_preconditions.neural_compute: CUDA-enabled framework, three fixed seeds 42/1234/31415, median per test row; retain seed dispersion
global_preconditions.gpu_exclusivity: one GPU timing worker; never train while a timing cell is active
global_preconditions.checkpoint: validate fold 0 or first ten terminal cells before a full run
global_preconditions.terminal_policy: preserve timeout, unsupported, adapter_error, and quality_failed in coverage

execution_authorization.authorized_by: benchmark coordinator based on the user's conditional request and independent strong-method review
execution_authorization.basis: The user requested scientifically justified benchmark work. Independent review supports the fixed-configuration runtime-only adaptation on the frozen C44 five-fold split. Fold 0 is only a metric-blind technical integrity checkpoint; passing it automatically continues the identical frozen run through folds 1-4.
execution_authorization.interpretation_limit: Five-fold OOF result for a local fixed-configuration method adaptation only; no Family-Aware reproduction, family-OOD claim, or leaderboard promotion.

scientific_contract: This is a runtime-only prediction study for the already measured local CUDA-Q MPS FP64, max_bond=16, abs_cutoff=1e-10, gesvdj configuration. It does not select approximation thresholds and is not a reproduction of the Family-Aware paper.

Primary target is warm state-execution wall time only: use the existing timed get_state warm repetitions; do not mix build, first-execution, result extraction, fidelity-reference, or end-to-end clocks. Shots are not part of this state-execution target.

The prediction/evaluation unit is one exact input-QASM SHA-256 group. First take the median of valid warm repetitions within each session/member record, then the median across records for that hash. This yields one target per hash and prevents aliases, sessions, and repetitions from becoming independent test samples.

Primary data are core_q2_q9 only. Keep every assigned hash in the denominator: finite timings with quality_failed remain valid runtime labels; report quality status separately and never feed it to the runtime predictor. adapter_error/unsupported rows remain unavailable with no imputation. Frontier q10_q16 remains coverage-only.

Primary evaluation reuses the pre-existing five folds keyed by exact QASM hash from the frozen Aer core split; verify the join and assert that no hash crosses train/test. This is a fixed-QASM generalization estimate where test families are represented in training, not family-OOD evidence.

Report family-known results by family strata. Add a separate family-OOD diagnostic only by holding out connected components of family aliases that share exact-QASM hashes; do not use family ID as an input for unseen-family predictions. Keep this diagnostic separate from the primary score.

Compare on identical hash rows and folds: train-fold median, static-QASM structural Ridge, and the existing Ma-Li-style graph architecture retrained as a local MPS-target adaptation. Family-conditioned variants, if included, are a separately named known-family diagnostic and cannot replace the structure-only family-OOD result.

Use log1p(seconds) fitting, train-only preprocessing/model selection, and report seconds MAE/MedAE, log error, p90/p99/max absolute error, coverage, and paired exact-hash bootstrap intervals. Preserve terminal statuses and all per-seed predictions.

Neural training must use CUDA with fixed seeds 42/1234/31415 and rowwise median predictions; retain seed dispersion. Reuse recorded measurements only: no new GPU timing, no concurrent GPU timing worker, no best-seed or outer-test selection.

Do not alter historical MPS quality-constrained tables, raw measurements, S82/S83, or the original family_aware_residual gate. The adaptation may claim only prediction of this fixed configuration's warm runtime on the stated panel/splits; no threshold-selection, general MPS, cross-engine, or simulator-selection claim.
pre_execution_checks: Validate raw-file and panel hashes plus the recorded CUDA-Q/environment/run-manifest provenance before training.

Emit exact-hash target/terminal-status inventory and fold-join audit; expected core accounting is 150 unique QASM hashes: 144 with finite runtime labels (142 quality-pass and 2 quality-failed) and 6 adapter_error/unavailable hashes. Quality-failed finite-time hashes remain in the runtime target set.
Verify every primary fold has train/test disjoint hashes and that test families are represented in train. Family-OOD materialization is outside this authorization and needs a later decision.

This conditional authorization covers all five frozen C44 folds, the three fixed graph seeds 42/1234/31415, and same-fold median/Ridge baselines. Fold 0 is a technical-only checkpoint: if exact-hash/fold coverage, zero leakage, all finite predictions, frozen environment, fixed baselines/seeds, and CUDA/PyG smoke pass, the runner automatically continues folds 1-4 unchanged. MAE, R-squared, ranking, prediction quality, or seed quality must not be inspected or used to decide continuation.

Before any CUDA activity, acquire both the shared Maestro timing lock and the host-wide /tmp/qre-benchmark-gpu-lease.lock with nonblocking flock, then verify no live timing controller or possible orphan spawn worker. Hold both locks through the CUDA preflight or the entire five-fold fit. S84 may be partial/blocked or absent; its results and completion do not affect previously measured MPS labels. Regenerate preflight in a new output directory after this gate revision.

Run the CUDA/PyG smoke and five-fold OOF only after those checks. Stop only for a technical failure such as target/fold/hash mismatch, leakage, missing/non-finite predictions, changed environment, CUDA smoke failure, active timing worker/lock, or invalid authorization. Fold metrics are outputs, never continuation gates.
promotion_requirements: A separate signed authorization is required for family-OOD, a changed representation/configuration, expanded method set, new timing, or promotion into a cross-method leaderboard.
Five-fold OOF outputs and same-hash paired metrics for all baselines, with terminal coverage and family-known/family-OOD claims kept distinct.
Independent QA confirms exact target boundary, no quality/status leakage, no alias leakage, and reproducible GPU training context.

Use the identical noisy-Aer warm-execution cell, exact-QASM hash groups, outer folds, and labels for all three GNN variants and tabular baselines.
Train neural variants on CUDA; retain 42/1234/31415 outputs. CPU is permitted only for frozen classical baselines.
Do not use family, source path, hash, timing repetition, or post-execution data as a feature.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Materialize and hash the three representation inputs.
Run leakage and shape tests without training.
Prepare a fold-0 command and environment check.
promotion_requirements: CUDA smoke test and fold-0 QA pass for every neural variant.
Five-fold OOF predictions, coverage and same-row pair table on the 162-core panel.
Frontier q10–q16 reported as coverage/scaling unless a separate frozen extrapolation contract is signed.

gates.reader_label: Family-Aware-inspired residual MLP, fixed MPS runtime adaptation
scientific_contract: Reuse existing fixed-chi16 MPS labels and C44 exact-QASM folds. No new simulator timing.
Use six structural features shared with the MPS Ridge baseline and a predicted-family residual branch with matched family-agnostic ablation.
Cross-fit predicted families on runtime-training rows; no true test-family input and no runtime target in the classifier.
Run CUDA with seeds 42/1234/31415; complete all five folds after a technical-only fold-0 checkpoint.
Hold the shared timing lock and host-wide /tmp/qre-benchmark-gpu-lease.lock throughout CUDA activity; check no live timing worker and do not require Maestro's result or completion.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Implement the frozen runtime-only architecture and cross-fitted family classifier.
Validate target/fold/input hashes, CUDA context and family-signal leakage, then run all five folds.
promotion_requirements: Complete per-seed and median OOF predictions on the 150-hash envelope; same-row metrics on 144 finite labels and the separate 142 quality-pass subset.
Register the adaptation's own method card and reader label; original joint Family-Aware remains unavailable under S83.
Keep threshold-selection and unseen-family claims out of this runtime-only result.

scientific_contract: Freeze an approximation ladder per engine/configuration before measurement.
For each circuit/context, measure warm runtime and compute a reference fidelity outside the timed boundary.
Define the prediction-time family signal for strict circuit OOF and separately define family-held-out evaluation.
